title: An Arm Made of Smart Servos: A Position Command That Is Quantised, Slow to Arrive and Answered by a Spring, and How to Hold a Pose Anyway

artifact.note: a joint made of a serial bus servo as a model: a position goal rounded to the servo's steps, a bus whose cycle time follows from the bytes of a write to all servos and a read from all of them at a baud rate, an internal loop that is a spring and damper with a limited torque and speed, the droop of that spring under a load, a goal shifted by the load over the stiffness to hold a pose, and the delay between a commanded ramp and the motion it causes at a given update rate
